name: NRK — Technical Standards for Delivery of Television Programmes (HD)

governance.spec_version: NRK v4.4 (2021), based on DPP v4.0 (2013)
governance.source: Technical Standards for Delivery of Television Programmes to NRK, Version 4.4 (2021)
governance.notes: NRK (Norway). English-language spec, mostly based on the UK DPP delivery document. Section 4.1 is the current enforced file spec; 4.3-4.12 (AS-11/DPP) are informational/future (NRK 'not ready to accept AS-11' yet). Video: MXF OP1a, XAVC Intra Class 100 / AVC-Intra 100 (100 Mbit/s, H.264 High 4:2:2 Intra L4.1), 1920x1080i/25 field-1 dominant, 4:2:2, 10-bit, BT.709, limited range (16-235/64-940, EBU R103). Audio: PCM 24-bit/48 kHz, 2/4/8 tracks (current; 4/16 future AS-11); 2-ch main stereo, 4-ch +M&E, 8-ch main 5.1 (FL FR C LFE Ls Rs); EBU R48/R123 code required; EBU R128 -23 LUFS (+/-1 LU live only), true peak fails >-1 dBTP (-3 recommended); line-up 1 kHz -18 dBFS EBU/GLITS. TC start 10:00:00:00 with 20s 100% bars + 7s ident clock leader (legacy 90s+30s). Subtitles: separate file (format not mandated); AD as separate BWF (EBU Tech 3285). Metadata: DPP metadata set v10; filenames UPPERCASE [A-Z 0-9 - _]. PSE not legally mandatory in Norway but encouraged (Harding FPA v2.5 / Ofcom guidance; DPP-approved device list); PSE Pass recorded in metadata. Delivery method agreed per broadcaster (nrkmaterials@nrk.no). Language no/nb/nn, jurisdiction NO.

codec.notes: XAVC Intra Class 100 / AVC-Intra 100 (H.264 High 4:2:2 Intra, Level 4.1), 100 Mbit/s, 10-bit. Current enforced HD codec (§4.1).

container.notes: MXF OP1a. Future: AS-11 v1.1 UK DPP HD shim (not yet accepted).

resolution.notes: Must fill active picture (no blanking; 2-px tolerance for CG/overlays).

frame_rate.notes: 1080i/25 (50 fields, EBU Tech 3299 System 2). 1080p/50 not accepted; 1080psf/25 only if broadcaster requires.

codec.notes: Linear PCM in AES3 streams. Unused tracks = PCM digital silence.

track_count.notes: Current (§4.1): 2, 4 or 8 PCM channels. 2-ch: T1/2 main stereo. 4-ch: +T3/4 M&E stereo. 8-ch: T1/2 main stereo + T3-8 main 5.1 (FL FR C LFE Ls Rs). Future AS-11: 4 or 16 (R123:16c/16d/16f). EBU R48/R123 track-allocation code required in metadata.

layout.notes: R48:2a / R123:4b (main stereo, +M&E), R123:4c (+AD on T3/4). Unused tracks carry PCM digital silence.

loudness.notes: EBU R128 Integrated -23.0 LUFS (no stated tolerance for file/tape delivery; +/-1.0 LU for live only). Max true peak fails if it exceeds -1 dBTP (-3 dBTP recommended). Line-up 1 kHz EBU/GLITS (BLITS for surround), reference -18 dBFS. LRA guidance <=18 LU.

subtitles.notes: Subtitles delivered as a separate file named identically to the MXF apart from extension; specific format (EBU STL / EBU-TT) not mandated in this document. Closed-caption metadata: type Hard-of-Hearing / Translation, ISO 639-2. Audio description as a separate BWF/B-WAV file (EBU Tech 3285) matching MXF duration/TC. Signing recorded in metadata.

metadata.notes: DPP minimum metadata set (DPP Metadata spreadsheet v10); 127-char free-text limit; ISO 639-2 language codes; PSE Pass (Yes/No/Not tested) mandatory. Filenames UPPERCASE, extension lowercase, chars [A-Z 0-9 - _] only.

timeline.notes: 100% colour bars (100/0/100/0, full raster; SMPTE bars not acceptable) + line-up tone from 09:59:30:00 (20s); ident clock/slate from 09:59:50:00 (7s, moving countdown, silence); black to 10:00:00:00. Legacy 90s bars + 30s clock permitted. End: fade/cut to silence, freeze/living hold 5s after end. Multipart: parts start on next whole minute.

luminance.tolerance_note: 10-bit 64-940 (8-bit 16-235). EBU R103: luminance Y -1% to +103% (-7..721 mV); gamut error if out-of-gamut >=1% of picture area.

video.pse_standard: Harding FPA v2.5 / Ofcom guidance (encouraged, not legally mandatory in NO)
